response.sql:
WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    e.type,
    AVG(b.spent / b.amount) as avg_ratio
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL 
    AND b.amount > 0
    AND b.spent IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.type
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean_ratio
  FROM type_averages
)
SELECT 
  ta.type,
  ta.avg_ratio,
  ta.avg_ratio - om.overall_mean_ratio as distance_from_mean
FROM type_averages ta
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY ta.type;

assumptions.assumption: amount > 0 to avoid division by zero; budget lines with amount ≤ 0 are excluded
Distance from the mean is the signed difference (can be negative), not absolute magnitude

alternatives.interpretation: If "how far" should report absolute distance rather than signed difference
alternatives.sql:
WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    e.type,
    AVG(b.spent / b.amount) as avg_ratio
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL 
    AND b.amount > 0
    AND b.spent IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.type
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean_ratio
  FROM type_averages
)
SELECT 
  ta.type,
  ta.avg_ratio,
  ABS(ta.avg_ratio - om.overall_mean_ratio) as distance_from_mean
FROM type_averages ta
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY ta.type;
